answer: Under EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained, recent honest service and reciprocity-weighted transitive endorsements. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted paths to established peers, it cannot gather enough weight to pass consensus. The bridge, mesa, and violet labels do not change this constraint: only validated interactions can build trust.
